abstract: Countries are accelerating actions to reduce food loss and waste to ensure global food security and sustainable development. Cooperatives are considered important channels for promoting the use of agricultural technologies and improving farmers' skills, which are regarded as key factors in reducing harvest losses. However, owing to data limitations, few systematic assessments of the effects of cooperative membership on food losses exist. On the basis of survey data from 703 maize growers in three major maize production areas in China, propensity score matching (PSM) and endogenous switching regression (ESR) were used in this study to evaluate the effects of cooperative membership on the maize harvest losses of households. The results revealed that membership significantly reduced maize harvest losses by 68%, saving farmers an average of 238.05 kg per ha, which is worth $91.92 per ha. Membership also contributed to minor pest attacks and better working attitudes during the harvest stage. Cooperative membership is critically important for China's food security, resource conservation, and environmental protection. If the average maize harvest loss reaches the level of loss observed among member households, then it is possible to meet the food consumption needs of 13.61 million people, saving 0.74 million ha of land and 0.29 million tons of fertilizer used for maize production and reducing carbon emissions by 4.04 million tons and the water footprint by 6.43 billion m 3 .
abstract_zh: 各国正加速行动减少粮食损失与浪费，以保障全球粮食安全与可持续发展。合作社被视为推广农业技术、提升农户技能的重要渠道，而这两者被认为是降低收获损失的关键因素。然而，受数据限制，关于合作社成员身份对粮食损失影响的系统性评估仍较为匮乏。本研究基于中国三大玉米主产区703户玉米种植户的调查数据，采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）与内生转换回归（ESR）方法，评估合作社成员身份对农户玉米收获损失的影响。结果表明：成员身份显著降低了68%的玉米收获损失，平均每公顷为农户节省238.05公斤，折合每公顷91.92美元。此外，成员身份还有助于减少收获阶段的虫害侵袭，并改善农户的工作态度。合作社成员身份对中国粮食安全、资源节约与环境保护具有关键意义。若玉米平均收获损失降至成员农户的水平，则可满足1360万人的粮食消费需求，节省74万公顷土地及29万吨玉米生产用化肥，减少404万吨碳排放，并降低64.3亿立方米的水足迹。

abstract: Unobserved objective output quality complicates the analysis of firm productivity and demand because higher‐quality products entail higher costs but offer greater consumption benefits. Using a panel of firms with output quality data, we decompose quantity‐based productivity into fundamental productivity and the costs of quality, and separate the demand residual into fundamental demand and quality benefits. Fundamental demand accounts for most revenue variation, whereas quality's revenue‐enhancing benefits are largely offset by its costs. During the 2008 global financial crisis, shifts in quality diverged from changes in fundamental productivity and demand, highlighting the role of quality in assessing firm and industry performance.
abstract_zh: 未观测到的客观产出质量使企业生产率与需求分析复杂化，因为更高质量的产品虽带来更高成本，却提供更大的消费效用。基于包含产出质量数据的企业面板数据，我们将基于数量的生产率分解为基础生产率与质量成本，并将需求残差分离为基础需求与质量收益。基础需求解释了大部分收入变动，而质量带来的收入提升效应在很大程度上被其成本所抵消。在2008年全球金融危机期间，质量变动与基础生产率及需求变化呈现分化态势，凸显了质量在评估企业与行业绩效中的关键作用。

abstract: I am happy to be here, if only virtually, to celebrate Jim's impact on the field of international economics, and to be part of a panel discussing Jim's impact on the study of “Trade policy: Then and now.” Taking the title of the panel literally, I am going to organize my comments into “Then,” and “Now.” And interpreting the ambit of the panel narrowly, I am going to make things personal and focus on Jim's impact on me (and my research)!
abstract_zh: 我很高兴能在此，即便只是以虚拟方式，庆祝吉姆对国际经济学领域的深远影响，并参与这场关于吉姆对“贸易政策：过去与现在”研究影响的专题讨论。严格遵循小组讨论的主题，我将把我的发言分为“过去”和“现在”两部分。而狭义地理解小组讨论的范围，我将使内容个人化，聚焦于吉姆对我本人（及我的研究）的影响！
title: Trade policy: Then and now
title_zh: 贸易政策：过去与现在

abstract: Wildlife interactions influence the value of outdoor recreation, but little prior work links welfare to wildlife abundance. We use a choice experiment to estimate willingness to pay for recreation as a function of the probability of seeing a species. Our estimates are analogous to the value of statistical life, so we term them the Òvalue of a statistical speciesÓ (VSS). We provide empirical VSS estimates of common North American species that may be transferable to benefit-cost analyses of comparable recreational settings supporting similar wildlife. We then show how they help assess wildlife management benefits and costs using a case study.
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Using Choice Experiment Data to Estimate the Value of a Statistical Species
title_zh: 利用选择实验数据估算统计物种的价值

abstract: This study quantifies market integration across U.S. biodiesel plant-level and wholesale markets, as well as between biodiesel and petroleum diesel wholesale markets. Using Diebold-Yilmaz (2012, 2014) connectedness measures and a rolling window approach, we examine how price connectedness evolves across regions and supply chain levels. We find strong intra-supply chain integration within biodiesel markets and substantial cross-market integration between biodiesel and petroleum diesel wholesale markets. Connectedness declines sharply post-2022, coinciding with the renewable diesel boom as established supply chain interactions and regional price dynamics shift to reflect new market conditions.
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Price Connectedness in U.S. Biodiesel and Petroleum Diesel Markets
title_zh: 美国生物柴油与石油柴油市场的价格联动性

abstract: How large and important are means-tested transfers to working-age households in the United States? Using microdata from the Survey of Income and Program Participation, we document that a substantial share of households, more than one-third of them, receive transfers in a given year. Conditional on receipt, transfers average about $17,000 in 2016 dollars, exceeding one-fifth of mean household income. For households with no income, total conditional transfers amount to $26,500, nearly one-third of the mean household income. Transfers decline sharply with income but remain surprisingly widespread even in the middle and upper portions of the distribution. The system substantially compresses inequality, and its redistributive role has grown over time, driven largely by the expansion of Medicaid. Non-medical transfers are strongly countercyclical, and benefit reduction rates (the implicit tax rates on the first dollar earned) are significant. We provide parametric estimates of effective transfer functions by program, household type, and income level, ready for use in quantitative work in macroeconomics and public finance.
abstract_zh: 美国面向劳动年龄家庭的经济状况调查转移支付规模及其重要性如何？利用收入与项目参与调查的微观数据，我们记录到，在给定年份中，有相当大比例的家庭（超过三分之一）获得了转移支付。在获得转移支付的家庭中，平均转移金额约为2016年美元的17,000美元，超过家庭平均收入的五分之一。对于无收入家庭，总条件转移支付金额达到26,500美元，接近家庭平均收入的三分之一。转移支付随收入增加而急剧下降，但在收入分布的中高区间仍出人意料地普遍存在。该系统显著压缩了不平等，其再分配作用随时间增强，这主要得益于医疗补助计划的扩张。非医疗转移支付具有强烈的逆周期性，且福利削减率（即对首美元收入的隐性税率）显著。我们提供了按项目、家庭类型和收入水平划分的有效转移函数参数估计，可直接用于宏观经济学和公共财政领域的定量研究。
title: Means-Tested Transfers in the U.S.: Facts and Parametric Estimates
title_zh: 美国经济状况调查转移支付：事实与参数估计

abstract: Unconditional full-refund policies are widely perceived as consumer-friendly. This paper shows that they can reduce consumer surplus compared to stricter return policies. We develop a model in which a monopolist sells products of uncertain reliability and chooses both the refund amount and the length of the return period. Consumers learn about product reliability during use, and the seller can salvage value from returned defective items. Under an unconditional full-refund policy, the seller can strategically shorten the return period to deter consumers from exploiting the generous return window (i.e., wardrobing). This effect is especially pronounced when consumers derive high utility from the product, as a longer free trial is too costly for the seller to offer. The shorter return period limits the seller’s ability to recover value from genuinely defective products, raising the seller’s effective production cost, which is ultimately transferred to consumers.
abstract_zh: 无条件全额退款政策被广泛视为对消费者友好。本文表明，与更严格的退货政策相比，此类政策可能减少消费者剩余。我们构建了一个模型，其中垄断者销售可靠性不确定的产品，并同时选择退款金额和退货期限的长度。消费者在使用过程中了解产品可靠性，而卖方可以从退回的缺陷产品中回收残值。在无条件全额退款政策下，卖方可以策略性地缩短退货期限，以阻止消费者利用慷慨的退货窗口（即“衣橱购物”行为）。当消费者从产品中获得高效用时，这一效应尤为显著，因为提供更长的免费试用期对卖方而言成本过高。较短的退货期限限制了卖方从真正有缺陷的产品中回收价值的能力，从而提高了卖方的有效生产成本，这一成本最终转嫁给消费者。
title: Do Unconditional Full Refunds Benefit Consumers?
title_zh: 无条件全额退款对消费者有利吗？

abstract: Pollution prevention is the EPA’s highest-priority approach to managing toxic chemicals, yet its effects on firm efficiency remain largely unexplored. We address this using a by-production stochastic frontier framework that models desirable output and emissions as linked but distinct production processes, allowing us to separately identify technical and environmental efficiency. The model is estimated across three broad U.S. manufacturing industries (NAICS 31, 32, and 33), using a panel of Compustat, TRI, and EPA P2 data over 1991–2016. Under maintained timing assumptions, we find that a 10% increase in cumulative source reduction improves technical efficiency by 0.09%–0.17% across industries, corresponding to $5.5–$11.2 million in additional real sales at the respective industry means. Source reduction also reduces environmental inefficiency in NAICS 32 and NAICS 33, implying reductions of 4,435–5,802 pounds of toxic releases at the industry means; the effect is not significant in NAICS 31. A disaggregated analysis reveals that different source-reduction activities operate through distinct channels, with material substitution as the most consistent driver of gains in both technical and environmental efficiency.
abstract_zh: 污染防治是美国环保署管理有毒化学品的最优先方法，然而其对厂商效率的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探索。我们通过一个副产品生产随机前沿框架来解决这一问题，该框架将期望产出与排放建模为相互关联但不同的生产过程，从而能够分别识别技术效率和环境效率。该模型基于1991年至2016年间Compustat、TRI和EPA P2数据的面板数据，在美国三大制造业（NAICS 31、32和33）中进行估计。在保持时间假设的前提下，我们发现累计源头削减增加10%可使各行业的技术效率提高0.09%至0.17%，对应各行业均值下额外实际销售额为550万至1120万美元。源头削减还降低了NAICS 32和NAICS 33中的环境无效率，意味着行业均值下有毒排放减少4，435至5，802磅；而在NAICS 31中该效应不显著。一项分解分析显示，不同的源头削减活动通过不同渠道发挥作用，其中材料替代是技术效率和环境效率提升最一致的驱动因素。
title: Does Pollution Prevention Enhance Firm Efficiency? Insights from U.S. Manufacturing Firms
title_zh: 污染预防能否提升企业效率？来自美国制造业企业的证据

abstract: Invasive alien species pose major ecological and socio-economic challenges, especially when they exert strong predation pressure on native resources while offering opportunities for commercial use. Addressing this dual role requires models that integrate ecological dynamics, economic incentives, and institutional policies. This paper develops a general bioeconomic framework for a predator–prey system subject to human interventions. The native resource is harvested for economic purposes, while the invasive predator can be controlled through both commercial exploitation and institutional removal. The analysis combines equilibrium methods and optimal control over finite horizons, capturing the interaction between long-run ecological regimes and short-term management objectives. The results characterize threshold conditions for species coexistence and identify how harvesting and institutional removal affect the ecological regimes of the system. The analysis shows that moderate exploitation of the invasive predator can enlarge the coexistence region, whereas eradication requires removal efforts exceeding its intrinsic growth rate. The optimal control analysis highlights the role of coordinated management instruments, with numerical results indicating that mixed market and institutional strategies outperform single-instrument policies. The framework is inspired by the interaction between the invasive blue crab (Callinectes sapidus) and native bivalves in Mediterranean coastal systems, and points to policy strategies that integrate ecological conservation, economic valorization, and institutional containment.
abstract_zh: 外来入侵物种带来了重大的生态和社会经济挑战，尤其是当它们对本地资源施加强烈捕食压力，同时又提供商业利用机会时。应对这种双重角色，需要整合生态动态、经济激励和制度政策的模型。本文针对受人类干预的捕食者—被捕食者系统，构建了一个通用的生物经济框架。本地资源因经济目的而被捕捞，而入侵捕食者则可通过商业开发和制度性清除两种方式进行控制。分析结合了均衡方法和有限时间范围内的最优控制，捕捉了长期生态制度与短期管理目标之间的相互作用。结果刻画了物种共存的条件阈值，并识别了捕捞和制度性清除如何影响系统的生态制度。分析表明，对入侵捕食者的适度开发可以扩大共存区域，而根除则需要清除努力超过其内在增长率。最优控制分析强调了协调管理工具的作用，数值结果表明，市场与制度混合策略优于单一工具政策。该框架受地中海沿海系统中入侵蓝蟹（*Callinectes sapidus*）与本地双壳类之间相互作用的启发，并指向整合生态保护、经济增值和制度遏制相结合的政策策略。
title: Exploitation and containment of invasive predators and native prey: A bioeconomic framework for balancing resource use and ecological risk
title_zh: 入侵捕食者与本地猎物的开发与控制：平衡资源利用与生态风险的生物经济框架

abstract: This paper estimates the elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS) from the aggregate consumption Euler equation using Kroencke’s (2017) unfiltered consumption data. Unlike the published NIPA series used in most studies, unfiltered consumption is designed to recover the latent series obscured by statistical smoothing. Using weak-instrument-robust GMM inference, we show that this measurement choice matters for EIS estimation. With conventional filtered consumption, confidence sets typically include zero and are often uninformative. With unfiltered consumption, confidence sets exclude zero and provide a positive lower bound. The near-zero EIS estimates in the literature may partly reflect a measurement artifact rather than household preferences.
abstract_zh: 本文利用Kroencke（2017）提出的未滤波消费数据，从总体消费欧拉方程中估计跨期替代弹性（EIS）。与多数研究中使用的已发布NIPA序列不同，未滤波消费旨在恢复被统计平滑所掩盖的潜在序列。采用弱工具变量稳健的广义矩估计（GMM）推断，我们证明这一测量选择对EIS估计具有重要影响。使用传统滤波消费数据时，置信集通常包含零且往往信息量不足；而采用未滤波消费数据时，置信集排除零并提供正的下界。文献中接近零的EIS估计可能部分反映的是测量伪象，而非家庭偏好特征。
title: Unfiltered Consumption and the Elasticity of Intertemporal Substitution
title_zh: 无过滤消费与跨期替代弹性

abstract: We analyze the distributional effects of climate policy by examining heterogeneity in households’ carbon intensity of consumption. We construct a novel dataset that includes information on the carbon intensity of 1.7 million individual households from 88 countries. First, we show that horizontal differences are generally larger than vertical differences. Then, we use supervised machine learning to analyze the non-linear contribution of household characteristics to the prediction of carbon intensity of consumption. Household income, proxied by total household expenditures, is usually an insufficient predictor for the additional costs of climate policy. Including household-level information beyond household income increases the accuracy of prediction. We identify ten clusters of countries that differ in the distribution of climate policy costs and their predictors. Our results highlight that, depending on the context, some compensation policies may be more effective in reducing overall heterogeneity than others.
abstract_zh: 我们通过考察家庭消费碳强度的异质性，分析了气候政策的分配效应。我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，包含来自88个国家170万个家庭消费碳强度的信息。首先，我们表明水平差异通常大于垂直差异。随后，我们运用监督式机器学习分析家庭特征对消费碳强度预测的非线性贡献。以家庭总支出作为收入代理指标，通常不足以预测气候政策的额外成本。在家庭收入之外纳入家庭层面的信息，能提高预测的准确性。我们识别出十个国家集群，它们在气候政策成本的分布及其预测因素上存在差异。我们的结果强调，根据具体情境，某些补偿政策在减少整体异质性方面可能比其他政策更为有效。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: The heterogeneous effects of climate policy on households: Evidence from 88 countries
title_zh: 气候政策对家庭异质性影响的证据：来自88个国家的分析

abstract: This paper studies the effects of rural electrification on girls' schooling and later life-course outcomes in rural China. We draw on the Rural Electrification through Small Hydropower (SHP-RE), which was rolled out across counties in three waves during the 1980s and 1990s. Using county-cohort data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate the effects of exposure to electrification by age 15. SHP-RE increased girls' upper-secondary enrollment by 5.1 percentage points, with no comparable gains for boys. The effects are concentrated among cohorts exposed during later childhood and early adolescence. Exposure also delayed women's age at first marriage and reduced the probability of marrying before age 20. Mechanism evidence is most consistent with reduced domestic labor burden for girls and greater adoption of labor-saving household technology. Counties electrified earlier also later exhibited higher shares of women with upper-secondary education or above and greater enterprise-registration density. Overall, the results show that rural electrification generated large and persistent gains for girls and women at key human-capital and life-course margins.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了农村电气化对中国农村女孩教育及后续人生轨迹的影响。我们利用通过小水电实现农村电气化（SHP-RE）项目，该项目在20世纪80年代和90年代分三波在县域推广。基于县-队列数据并采用双重差分设计，我们估算了15岁前接触电气化的效应。SHP-RE使女孩的高中阶段入学率提高了5.1个百分点，而对男孩则无显著类似增益。这些效应集中在童年后期及青春期早期接触电气化的队列中。接触电气化还推迟了女性的初婚年龄，并降低了20岁前结婚的概率。机制证据最符合女孩家务劳动负担减轻及省力家用技术采纳增加的解释。较早电气化的县后来也表现出女性高中及以上教育比例更高以及企业注册密度更大。总体而言，研究结果表明，农村电气化在关键人力资本和人生轨迹方面为女孩和女性带来了显著且持久的收益。

title: The power of electricity: Small hydropower and girls’ education

abstract: Efforts to measure and advance research on intimate partner violence (IPV) often rely on the analysis of data collected from confidential household surveys. Yet, even in confidential settings, women may underreport IPV. I present evidence that, in Sub-Saharan Africa, women with husbands who consume alcohol are 6.4 percentage points less likely to self-report severe physical and/or sexual IPV during evening surveys than during morning surveys. This finding occurs because the expected marginal costs of IPV reporting increase over the day with husbands’ alcohol consumption. My back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that, even if only 10% of interviews conducted by nationally representative IPV survey efforts occur during the evening, time-of-day effects exclude over 314,496 women from estimates of the most severe forms of IPV across Sub-Saharan Africa.
abstract_zh: 衡量和推进亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）研究的工作，往往依赖于对保密性家庭调查所收集数据的分析。然而，即便在保密环境中，女性也可能低报IPV。我提供的证据表明，在撒哈拉以南非洲，丈夫饮酒的女性在晚间调查中自我报告严重身体和/或性IPV的可能性比晨间调查低6.4个百分点。这一发现之所以出现，是因为随着一天中丈夫饮酒量的增加，IPV报告的预期边际成本也随之上升。我的粗略估算显示，即使全国代表性IPV调查工作中仅有10%的访谈在晚间进行，时间效应也会使撒哈拉以南非洲超过314,496名女性被排除在最严重形式IPV的估计之外。
title: Time-of-day effects on disclosure of intimate partner violence
title_zh: 披露亲密伴侣暴力行为的时间效应

abstract: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) is the largest federal nutrition assistance program in the United States, yet many eligible households do not participate due to administrative burdens, stigma, and geographic access constraints. We examine whether the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot (OPP), which allows beneficiaries to redeem benefits online, affects program participation. Using a difference‐in‐differences design with state‐level data from 2017 to 2021, we find that SNAP OPP increases program participation per capita by 13.7% (1.6 percentage points) and participation among individuals below the poverty line by 11.3% (11 percentage points). Event‐study estimates indicate effects emerge within three months and persist thereafter. Participation gains are larger in states with higher digital infrastructure (computer ownership and internet access) and greater vehicle access, indicating that online and physical access function as complements. States with higher shares of elderly residents and households with children also exhibit stronger responses. These findings suggest that enabling online benefit redemption can expand safety net access, though benefits vary systematically with local infrastructure and demographic composition.
abstract_zh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）是美国最大的联邦营养援助项目，但由于行政负担、污名化以及地理可达性限制，许多符合条件的家庭并未参与其中。我们考察了SNAP在线购买试点项目（OPP）——该试点允许受益人通过在线方式兑换福利——是否会影响项目参与率。利用2017年至2021年的州级数据，采用双重差分法进行分析，我们发现SNAP OPP使人均项目参与率提高了13.7%（1.6个百分点），贫困线以下个体的参与率提高了11.3%（11个百分点）。事件研究估计表明，该效应在三个月内显现并持续存在。在数字基础设施（计算机拥有率和互联网接入率）更完善以及车辆可及性更高的州，参与率增幅更大，这表明在线与实体可达性具有互补作用。老年居民比例较高以及有儿童家庭比例较高的州也表现出更强的响应。这些发现表明，允许在线福利兑换能够扩大安全网的可及性，但其效益会因当地基础设施和人口结构的差异而呈现系统性变化。
title: Online Benefit Redemption and SNAP Participation: Evidence From the SNAP Online Purchasing Pilot
title_zh: 在线福利兑换与SNAP参与：来自SNAP在线购买试点的证据

abstract: Aligning electric vehicle (EV) charging with periods of abundant clean energy is essential for decarbonizing transportation. In solar-dominated grids, this requires shifting charging to midday hours – when vehicles are typically parked at workplaces. Yet workplace charging networks operate under institutional constraints such as shared infrastructure, bundled parking and charging services, and limited willingness to require drivers to move vehicles, making time-of-day pricing and active management difficult to implement. In a natural field experiment (n = 629 drivers) across a large workplace charging network, we randomize time-invariant price discounts and environmental nudges that emphasize the environmental benefits of daytime charging. Price discounts modestly increase workplace charging but shift charging toward off-solar periods when charger occupancy is lower, while environmental nudges re-time charging toward solar hours without increasing total demand. A follow-up experiment shows that these timing responses are driven by perceived charger scarcity and congestion under price discounts. Finally, we quantify the abatement costs per ton of of these shifts.
abstract_zh: 将电动汽车（EV）充电与丰富的清洁能源时段对齐，对于交通脱碳至关重要。在以太阳能为主的电网中，这要求将充电转移至正午时段——此时车辆通常停放在工作场所。然而，工作场所充电网络受制于制度性约束，如共享基础设施、停车与充电服务捆绑，以及要求驾驶员移动车辆的意愿有限，这使得分时定价和主动管理难以实施。在一项覆盖大型工作场所充电网络的自然实地实验中（n = 629名驾驶员），我们随机分配了时间不变的折扣价格和强调日间充电环境效益的环境助推信息。价格折扣适度增加了工作场所充电量，但将充电转移至充电器占用率较低的太阳能低谷时段，而环境助推信息则将充电重新安排至太阳能高峰时段，且未增加总需求。后续实验表明，这些时间响应是由价格折扣下感知到的充电器稀缺性和拥堵所驱动的。最后，我们量化了这些转移每吨的减排成本。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Electric vehicle charging at the workplace: Experimental evidence on incentives and environmental nudges
title_zh: 工作场所电动汽车充电：激励与环境助推的实验证据

abstract: We assess the welfare benefits of government-funded emergency support to the financial sector, considering its effects on the probability of financial crises. In our quantitative general equilibrium model, the financial crisis probability depends on household portfolio choices and on financial intermediaries' balance sheet positions, both influenced by capital adequacy constraints (CAR) and ex-ante known emergency support provisions. The welfare-optimal CAR balances the output costs of equity financing and financial stability gains and ranges from 12.7 to 12.8 \% depending on emergency support. Comprehensive support is welfare improving under the current and optimal CAR, but likely welfare decreasing at lower ratios, or with a significant amount of shadow banking activity undermining the effectiveness of capital adequacy regulation.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了政府资助的金融部门紧急支持措施的福利收益，考虑了其对金融危机概率的影响。在我们的定量一般均衡模型中，金融危机概率取决于家庭投资组合选择及金融中介机构的资产负债表状况，这两者均受资本充足率约束（CAR）和事前已知的紧急支持条款影响。福利最优的CAR在股权融资产出成本与金融稳定收益之间取得平衡，根据紧急支持的不同，其范围在12.7%至12.8%之间。在当前及最优CAR下，全面支持能改善福利，但在较低比率下，或当影子银行活动显著削弱资本充足率监管有效性时，全面支持可能反而降低福利。
title: Are bank bailouts welfare improving?
title_zh: 银行救助能否改善社会福利？

abstract: We examine how pesticide expenditure relates to the probability distribution of yield and revenue per hectare in apple production in northern Italy. Using a flexible moment-based approach, we find that pesticide expenditure is negatively associated with downside risk in yield and revenue, whereas late frosts are positively associated with downside risk in yield. Sensitivity analyses show that mean-equation estimates are robust to unobserved confounders, while negative semi-variance models are less robust overall. Only the pesticide–expected outcome relationship appears plausibly causal. Therefore, conclusions about pesticides as risk-increasing or risk-decreasing inputs should be made with caution.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了意大利北部苹果生产中农药支出与每公顷产量及收益概率分布之间的关系。采用灵活的基于矩的方法，我们发现农药支出与产量和收益的下行风险呈负相关，而晚霜则与产量的下行风险呈正相关。敏感性分析表明，均值方程估计对未观测到的混杂因素具有稳健性，而负半方差模型整体稳健性较弱。只有农药与预期结果之间的关系似乎具有合理的因果性。因此，关于农药作为风险增加或风险减少投入的结论应谨慎得出。
title: The relationship between pesticides and risk in apple production
title_zh: 农药与苹果生产风险的关系

abstract: Afforestation, which involves converting cropland to forestland, can provide multiple ecosystem services. Consequently, public incentive programs such as those administered by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), and, increasingly, private incentive programs, provide funding to farmers to convert their land to forest. However, the degree to which afforestation incentives provide greater ecosystem services depends on the degree to which afforestation is additional, both in the short- and long-term. Incentives are additional if they lead to forest growth that would not have occurred without payments. In this study, we assess the additionality of incentives for afforestation of cropland in USDA's Conservation Reserve Program over a two-decade time span. We estimate impacts using a regression discontinuity design that leverages the Conservation Reserve Program's General Signup auction mechanism. We use remote-sensing data to compare the extent of trees on land that had rejected and accepted offers to enroll in the program. We find that 32 to 65 percent of land enrolled is additional; and that impacts of incentives on tree cover remain steady from nine to twenty years after initial offers are made.
abstract_zh: 造林，即将农田转变为林地，能够提供多种生态系统服务。因此，公共激励计划，如美国农业部（USDA）管理的项目，以及日益增多的私人激励计划，向农民提供资金以将其土地转为林地。然而，造林激励措施所能带来的生态系统服务增量，取决于造林在短期和长期内的额外性程度。如果激励措施促进了在没有补贴情况下不会发生的森林增长，则这些激励具有额外性。在本研究中，我们评估了美国农业部保护储备计划中农田造林激励措施在二十年时间跨度内的额外性。我们利用回归不连续设计，借助保护储备计划的一般签约拍卖机制来估计影响。我们使用遥感数据，比较了被拒绝和接受加入该计划提议的土地上的树木覆盖程度。我们发现，32%至65%的已注册土地具有额外性；且激励措施对树木覆盖的影响在初始提议提出后的九至二十年间保持稳定。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Additionality of Afforestation Incentives: Evidence from the Conservation Reserve Program
title_zh: 造林激励的额外性：来自保护储备计划的证据

abstract: While international knowledge transfer drives structural transformation, the diffusion of tacit knowledge—the complex skills and procedures essential for sophisticated production—remains constrained by the need for face-to-face interaction. This paper identifies outbound business travel as a distinct channel for overcoming this friction. Exploiting a panel of 113 countries (1995–2020) and a System GMM framework to address endogeneity, I document a robust positive association between business travel and economic complexity. I show that this relationship is conditional on domestic political institutions: the returns to travel are amplified in inclusive, open political environments but vanish in highly centralized systems. Furthermore, I find evidence of diminishing marginal returns, suggesting that the benefits of travel moderate as connectivity channels saturate. I conclude that inclusive institutions function as a critical “absorptive filter” mechanism, enabling the tacit knowledge acquired abroad to translate effectively into national productive capabilities.
abstract_zh: 尽管国际知识转移推动着结构性转型，但隐性知识——复杂生产所需的关键技能与流程——的传播仍受限于面对面互动的需求。本文指出，出境商务差旅是克服这一摩擦的独特渠道。基于113个国家1995-2020年的面板数据，并采用系统GMM框架处理内生性问题，本文证实商务差旅与经济复杂度之间存在稳健的正向关联。研究表明，这一关系受国内政治制度调节：在包容开放的政治环境中，差旅的回报效应被放大，但在高度集权体制下则完全消失。此外，本文发现边际回报递减的证据，表明随着连通渠道趋于饱和，差旅收益将逐步减弱。结论指出，包容性制度作为关键的"吸收过滤"机制，能够使海外获取的隐性知识有效转化为国家生产能力。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Business travel, institutions, and economic complexity
title_zh: 商务旅行、制度与经济复杂性

abstract: This paper examines whether traditional gender norms are associated with well-being penalties for the rising share of women who are more educated than their husbands (hypogamy). Using panel data from the Japanese Panel Survey of Consumers (JPSC) covering the period of 1993 to 2020, the results show that women in hypogamous marriages report lower life satisfaction than other married women. The negative association is less pronounced for more recent marriage cohorts, as well as for women with less traditional norms. Moreover, the association shows stronger negative well-being implications for hypogamous women whose intra-household role is not in line with norm-based expectations.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了传统性别规范是否与日益增多的“妻强夫弱”（即妻子受教育程度高于丈夫）婚姻中女性的幸福感损失相关。基于1993年至2020年日本消费者面板调查（JPSC）的面板数据，结果显示，处于“妻强夫弱”婚姻中的女性报告的生活满意度低于其他已婚女性。这种负向关联在较晚近的婚姻队列中以及传统观念较弱的女性中不那么显著。此外，对于家庭内部角色不符合规范预期的“妻强夫弱”女性，这种关联表现出更强的负面幸福感影响。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Higher education, lower satisfaction: hypogamy and traditional norms in Japan
title_zh: 高等教育，更低满意度：日本的低嫁婚与传统规范

abstract: This paper develops a general equilibrium framework to examine the welfare implications of aggregate-demand information derived from payment data. The disclosure of such information tends to improve aggregate welfare when interest rates are low but may reduce welfare when rates are high. If a central bank controls information disclosure, it can craft noisy messages that encourage investment and benefit welfare through a form of Bayesian persuasion. If the information is instead produced by private banks and traded in a competitive market, excessive information production may happen. Finally, privacy concerns may dissuade some consumers from using digital payments, thereby decreasing the precision of aggregate-demand information, but it need not reduce welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个一般均衡框架，用以考察源自支付数据的总体需求信息对福利的影响。当利率较低时，此类信息的披露往往能提升总体福利，但在利率较高时则可能降低福利。若中央银行掌控信息披露，它能通过一种贝叶斯说服的形式，设计出带有噪声的信息，以鼓励投资并增进福利。相反，若信息由私人银行生产并在竞争性市场中交易，则可能出现信息过度生产的情况。最后，隐私担忧可能促使部分消费者放弃使用数字支付，从而降低总体需求信息的精确度，但这并不必然导致福利减少。
title: Payment data, information disclosure, and privacy
title_zh: 支付数据、信息披露与隐私

abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between monetary policy and financial stress by distinguishing informational effects from conventional policy transmission. Using Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) with monetary policy shock decomposition, Double Machine Learning (DML), and Bayesian Structural Time Series (BSTS) methods, we examine how monetary policy affects the US Financial Stress Index. The results reveal a significant negative relationship between monetary policy shocks and financial stress, largely driven by central bank information shocks rather than pure monetary policy shocks. DML estimates confirm the robustness of this finding after accounting for nonlinear macro-financial interactions. BSTS counterfactual analysis indicates that financial stress remained persistently above its no-tightening trajectory during the post-2022 tightening cycle, suggesting that sustained monetary tightening contributed to elevated financial stress over time. Rolling-window regressions further reveal substantial regime dependence in the monetary policy – financial stress relationship.
abstract_zh: 本文通过区分信息效应与传统政策传导机制，探讨了货币政策与金融压力之间的关系。运用普通最小二乘法（OLS）结合货币政策冲击分解、双重机器学习（DML）及贝叶斯结构时间序列（BSTS）方法，我们考察了货币政策如何影响美国金融压力指数。研究结果显示，货币政策冲击与金融压力之间存在显著的负相关关系，这一关系主要由中央银行信息冲击驱动，而非纯粹的政策冲击。DML估计在考虑非线性宏观金融交互作用后，确认了这一发现的稳健性。BSTS反事实分析表明，在2022年后的紧缩周期中，金融压力持续高于无紧缩情景下的轨迹，暗示持续的货币紧缩随时间推移加剧了金融压力。滚动窗口回归进一步揭示了货币政策与金融压力关系中的显著体制依赖性。
title: Monetary policy and financial stress: a multi-method causal analysis
title_zh: 货币政策与金融压力：一种多方法因果分析

abstract: This article examines how nationality-based employment quotas affect wages using player-level data from the Canadian Football League (CFL), where teams are required to field a minimum number of Canadian players. Using salary data from 2021 to 2025, I find that Canadian players earn approximately 9–11% more than comparable American players on average. Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition shows that although American players possess stronger observable performance characteristics, Canadian players receive higher returns to these characteristics. I further validate these findings by showing that Canadian all-stars receive a premium relative to their American counterparts, especially in positions with a lower supply of domestic labour. These findings contribute to the literature on labour market regulation by illustrating how binding employment quotas shape wage determination in highly specialized and skilled labour markets. The results inform policy debates about employment protections, visa restrictions and local hiring requirements.
abstract_zh: 本文利用加拿大橄榄球联盟（CFL）的球员层面数据，考察基于国籍的就业配额如何影响工资水平，该联盟要求各队必须安排最低数量的加拿大球员上场。基于2021年至2025年的薪资数据，我发现加拿大球员平均比可比美国球员多赚约9%至11%。Oaxaca–Blinder分解显示，尽管美国球员在可观测的表现特征上更为突出，但加拿大球员在这些特征上获得了更高的回报。我进一步验证了这些发现，表明加拿大全明星球员相对于其美国同行享有溢价，尤其是在本土劳动力供给较低的职位上。这些发现为劳动力市场规制文献做出了贡献，阐明了具有约束力的就业配额如何在高度专业化和技能密集型的劳动力市场中塑造工资决定机制。研究结果对关于就业保护、签证限制及本地雇佣要求的政策辩论具有参考意义。
title: Nationality quotas and wages in professional sports: evidence from the Canadian Football League
title_zh: 国籍配额与职业体育薪资：来自加拿大橄榄球联盟的证据

abstract: China’s renewable energy sector sits at the heart of a deepening contest between techno-nationalist rivals. Whether R&D investment shields firms from the resulting disruption or heightens their vulnerability remains an open question. Using quarterly panel data from China’s new energy index constituents over 2016 to 2025, this paper allows the marginal effect of R&D on firm resilience to vary continuously with geopolitical risk. R&D intensity is positively associated with future return on assets (ROA) and return on equity (ROE) across specifications. Its relationship with resilience, however, proves conditional. Innovative firms hold a stability advantage when conditions are calm, but that advantage reverses during elevated tension, with R&D-intensive firms experiencing larger drawdowns and heightened tail risk. State-owned enterprises (SOEs) bear a far steeper market penalty than private firms when geopolitical risk spikes, consistent with their greater international visibility. These patterns suggest a technological exposure mechanism in which the cross-border linkages that sustain innovative capability become transmission channels for geopolitical shocks. The evidence implies that policies promoting R&D and those managing geopolitical exposure cannot be designed in isolation.
abstract_zh: 中国可再生能源产业正处于技术民族主义对手之间日益加深的竞争核心。研发投资是使企业免受由此产生的干扰，还是加剧其脆弱性，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。利用2016年至2025年中国新能源指数成分股的季度面板数据，本文允许研发对企业韧性的边际效应随地缘政治风险连续变化。在各种设定下，研发强度与未来资产回报率（ROA）和净资产收益率（ROE）呈正相关。然而，其与韧性的关系则表现为条件性的。在局势平稳时，创新型企业具有稳定性优势，但在紧张局势升级期间，这一优势发生逆转，研发密集型企业面临更大的回撤和更高的尾部风险。当地缘政治风险飙升时，国有企业（SOEs）比私营企业承受更为陡峭的市场惩罚，这与其更高的国际可见度一致。这些模式揭示了一种技术暴露机制，其中支撑创新能力跨境联系成为地缘政治冲击的传导渠道。证据表明，促进研发的政策与管理地缘政治暴露的政策不能孤立设计。

title: The double edge of innovation: geopolitical risk and the conditional value of R&D in China’s renewable energy sector
title_zh: 创新的双刃剑：地缘政治风险与中国可再生能源部门研发的条件价值

abstract: This paper examines whether the Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax reduces bank profitability and regulatory capital, and for which banks the effects are strongest. We use a quarterly exposure-based difference-in-differences design around 2024Q1, where treatment intensity is defined by pre-2024 low-tax exposure among in-scope banks. The analysis uses a quarterly bank-level panel for 2014–2024 and exploits predetermined cross-sectional heterogeneity in low-tax exposure while controlling for bank and quarter fixed effects. The headline estimates show that post-2024 profitability and capital buffers decline more for high-exposure banks: profit after tax falls by about 2.2 basis points of assets per quarter and Tier 1 buffers by about 0.09 percentage points in the baseline specification. Higher low-tax exposure is not interpreted as vulnerability per se. The downside channel is concentrated where high pre-reform low-tax exposure coincides with limited initial capital headroom: event-study, placebo, matched-sample, and split-sample evidence all point to larger post-2024 capital-buffer compression for thin-buffer banks. Overall, the results indicate modest average effects but meaningful tail risk for banks that combine high minimum-tax exposure with thin initial capital buffers.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了支柱二全球最低税是否降低了银行盈利能力和监管资本，以及哪些银行受到的影响最为显著。我们采用基于季度暴露水平的双重差分设计，以2024年第一季度为政策节点，将受覆盖银行在2024年前的低税暴露程度定义为处理强度。分析基于2014-2024年银行层面季度面板数据，利用预先确定的低税暴露截面异质性，同时控制银行和季度固定效应。主要估计结果显示，2024年后高暴露银行的盈利能力和资本缓冲下降幅度更大：在基准设定中，税后利润每季度下降约2.2个基点（以资产计），一级资本缓冲下降约0.09个百分点。较高的低税暴露本身并不被解读为脆弱性。其负面传导渠道集中于改革前低税暴露较高且初始资本缓冲空间有限的银行：事件研究、安慰剂检验、匹配样本和分样本证据均表明，资本缓冲薄弱的银行在2024年后资本缓冲压缩幅度更大。总体而言，研究结果表明平均效应温和，但对于初始资本缓冲薄弱且面临较高最低税暴露的银行而言，存在显著的尾部风险。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Bank capital and the minimum corporate tax
title_zh: 银行资本与最低企业税

abstract: We study optimal nonlinear income taxation when productivity depends negatively on labor supply (labor-supply-dependent productivity, LSDP). Relative to a benchmark model with fixed productivities, we find that LSDP leads to higher optimal marginal tax rates, especially for higher-income individuals, and greater redistribution. The key mechanism is that, under LSDP, marginal taxation becomes a more effective screening instrument.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当生产率与劳动供给呈负相关（即劳动供给依赖型生产率，LSDP）时的最优非线性所得税问题。与生产率固定的基准模型相比，我们发现LSDP会导致更高的最优边际税率，尤其是对高收入群体而言，并带来更强的再分配效应。其关键机制在于，在LSDP条件下，边际税收成为一种更有效的筛选工具。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Optimal redistribution with labor supply dependent productivity
title_zh: 劳动供给依赖型生产率下的最优再分配

abstract: This paper applies the economic approach to the history of Christianity in the religious environment of the Roman Empire, a ground already covered by Stark, Ekelund and Tollison. We show that Greco-Roman religion was not in decline and was not threatened by Christianity either in terms of numbers or influence, but it was a fragile system because it lacked a professional priestly class with an interest in its continuance; hence, when the emperors raised Christianity to state religion, it was doomed. Christianity rose slowly and inconspicuously, struggling to extricate itself from its Jewish apocalyptic beginnings; it was not a superior doctrine, and specifically not a superior afterlife promise, that drove its growth in its sectarian centuries. Rather, Christians were able to achieve a distinctive doctrinal identity and organizational unity only when Toleration offered them both opportunity and incentive to become a universal religion, and the emperors bet on that. On this reading, for all it was hell-bent on destroying paganism, Christianity emerged as its killer only by accident.
abstract_zh: 本文运用经济学方法，探讨了罗马帝国宗教环境中基督教的历史，这一领域已有Stark、Ekelund和Tollison的研究基础。我们指出，希腊罗马宗教并未衰退，也未在人数或影响力上受到基督教的威胁，但它是一个脆弱的体系，因为缺乏一个对其存续有利益关联的专业祭司阶层；因此，当皇帝将基督教提升为国教时，它便注定消亡。基督教缓慢而不显眼地兴起，艰难地摆脱其犹太末世论起源；并非其教义更为优越，特别是并非其来世承诺更为出色，推动了其在教派世纪的成长。相反，只有当宽容政策为基督徒提供了成为普世宗教的机会和激励时，他们才能实现独特的教义认同和组织统一，而皇帝们则押注于此。据此解读，尽管基督教一心要摧毁异教，但它成为异教的终结者纯属偶然。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The rise of Christianity, the demise of Greco-Roman religion, and economics
title_zh: 基督教兴起、希腊罗马宗教衰落与经济学

abstract: The Borda count offers a promising alternative to counteract the growing polarization of party systems by incentivizing moderate party strategies. However, empirical evidence on the Borda count is still lacking. This paper presents results from an online survey conducted in the aftermath of the 2025 German federal election, in which respondents were asked for their vote choice under a Borda count system. Participants were randomly assigned to one of two conditions: in the first, they could rank up to three out of seven parties; in the second, they could rank all seven parties. The findings show that more ranks considered, the more fragmented the election result. It also shows that the Borda count has mixed effects on policy congruence between voters and parliament. Respondents’ overall acceptance of the Borda rule was moderate to negative, with many of the objections cited were based on misconceptions about the system’s consequences.
abstract_zh: 波达计数法通过激励政党采取温和策略，为应对政党体系日益加剧的两极分化提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，关于波达计数法的实证证据仍然匮乏。本文基于2025年德国联邦大选后开展的一项在线调查，呈现了受访者在波达计数法下的投票选择结果。参与者被随机分配到两种情境之一：第一种情境中，他们最多可对七个政党中的三个进行排序；第二种情境中，他们可对所有七个政党进行排序。研究结果表明，可排序的政党数量越多，选举结果越分散。同时，波达计数法对选民与议会之间的政策一致性产生了混合效应。受访者对波达规则的整体接受度处于中等偏负面水平，且许多反对意见源于对该制度后果的误解。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: How voters choose under the Borda rule: evidence from a post-election survey experiment in Germany 2025
title_zh: 博尔达规则下选民如何选择：来自德国2025年选举后调查实验的证据

abstract: Governments increasingly use pilot experimentation before national policy rollouts, but this strategy introduces policy uncertainty until reforms are permanently institutionalized. We study how resolving this uncertainty affects asset prices, exploiting China’s 2020 revision of the Land Management Law, which elevated previously experimental rural land reform pilots into a binding national legal framework. Using difference-in-differences estimates on land transactions in Deqing County from 2015 to 2022, we find that legal institutionalization increased rural construction land prices by 12.3%. This effect emerged immediately after institutionalization and gradually faded, consistent with belief updating and supply adjustment. Heterogeneity analysis supports the credible commitment channel: markets with greater state-owned enterprise (SOE) participation during the pilot phase show smaller effects, as state-owned enterprises’ privileged access to policy information had already driven prices toward uncertainty-free levels; and industrial land with 50-year tenure responds more strongly than commercial land with 40-year tenure, reflecting greater renewal risk exposure under shorter contracts. These findings highlight the asset-pricing costs of policy uncertainty and the value of credible commitment in transition economies.
abstract_zh: 各国政府在推行全国性政策之前，越来越多地采用试点实验的方式，但这一策略在改革永久制度化之前引入了政策不确定性。我们研究了消除这种不确定性如何影响资产价格，利用中国2020年《土地管理法》修订作为自然实验，该修订将此前实验性的农村土地改革试点提升为具有约束力的国家法律框架。通过对德清县2015年至2022年土地交易的差分估计，我们发现法律制度化使农村建设用地价格提高了12.3%。这一效应在制度化后立即显现并逐渐消退，与信念更新和供给调整相一致。异质性分析支持可信承诺渠道：试点阶段国有企业参与度较高的市场效应较小，因为国有企业获取政策信息的特权渠道已使价格趋近于无不确定性水平；此外，50年产权的工业用地比40年产权的商业用地反应更为强烈，反映出较短合同期限下更大的续期风险敞口。这些发现凸显了政策不确定性的资产定价成本以及转型经济中可信承诺的价值。

abstract: By focusing on an environment where non-productive players obtain non-negative payoffs, we characterize a generalization of the egalitarian Shapley values.
abstract_zh: 通过聚焦于非生产性参与者获得非负收益的环境，我们刻画了平等主义Shapley值的一种推广形式。
title: Null players, solidarity, and a generalization of the egalitarian Shapley values
title_zh: 零参与人、团结性与平等夏普利值的推广

abstract: Renewable energy development is central to climate change mitigation, but whether it also reduces urban–rural income inequality remains unclear. Using panel data for 271 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2005 to 2019, we combine two-way fixed-effects models with an instrumental-variable strategy to estimate the effect of renewable energy development on the urban–rural income gap. The results show that renewable energy development significantly reduces urban–rural income inequality: a one-standard-deviation increase lowers the gap by about 11%, and this finding remains robust across multiple robustness checks. The effect is more evident in regions with richer solar resources, lower fossil energy dependence, and lower urbanization levels. Mechanism analyses further suggest that this effect operates by improving rural employment and enhancing educational accessibility in rural areas. We also find that the inequality-reducing effect is significantly strengthened in regions with more developed green finance, highlighting the enabling role of green finance in renewable expansion. These findings show that renewable energy development can generate both climate and equity gains, with important implications for coordinated urban–rural development. We therefore recommend prioritizing renewable projects in rural areas with strong resource endowments and lower urbanization levels, while strengthening green finance systems to support more inclusive development.
abstract_zh: 可再生能源发展是减缓气候变化的核心，但其是否也能缩小城乡收入差距尚不明确。利用2005年至2019年中国271个地级市的面板数据，我们结合双向固定效应模型与工具变量策略，估计了可再生能源发展对城乡收入差距的影响。结果表明，可再生能源发展显著降低了城乡收入不平等：一个标准差水平的提升可使差距缩小约11%，且这一发现在多项稳健性检验中保持一致。该效应在太阳能资源更丰富、化石能源依赖度更低以及城镇化水平较低的地区更为显著。机制分析进一步表明，这一效应通过改善农村就业和提升农村教育可及性发挥作用。我们还发现，在绿色金融发展水平更高的地区，这一缩小不平等的效应显著增强，凸显了绿色金融在可再生能源扩张中的赋能作用。这些发现表明，可再生能源发展能够同时带来气候与公平双重收益，对城乡协调发展具有重要启示。因此，我们建议优先在资源禀赋优越且城镇化水平较低的农村地区布局可再生能源项目，同时加强绿色金融体系建设，以支持更具包容性的发展。

abstract: We study empirically and theoretically the effects of international financial flows on resource allocation. Using the universe of firms in Hungary, we show that removing capital controls lowers firms’ cost of capital and increases household consumption, with the latter playing a dominant role. The consumption channel leads to reallocation of resources toward high expenditure elasticity activities – such as services – promoting both the expansion of incumbents and firm entry. A multi-sector heterogeneous firm model replicates these dynamics. Our model shows that non-homotheticity in consumption can quantitatively account for the reallocation of resources towards services and successfully replicates the dynamics of aggregate productivity following episodes of financial openness.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实证与理论研究国际金融流动对资源配置的影响。利用匈牙利全部企业数据，我们发现取消资本管制降低了企业的资本成本并增加了家庭消费，其中消费渠道起主导作用。消费渠道导致资源向高支出弹性活动（如服务业）重新配置，既促进了现有企业的扩张，也推动了新企业进入。一个多部门异质性企业模型复现了这些动态变化。我们的模型表明，消费中的非位似性能够从数量上解释资源向服务业重新配置的现象，并成功复现了金融开放后全要素生产率的动态变化。
title: The Micro and Macro Dynamics of Capital Flows
title_zh: 资本流动的微观与宏观动态

abstract: We investigate how technologies that reduce the costs of monitoring by central authorities have shaped the historical transition from small patrimonial states to large bureaucratic organizations. Our analysis is based on a novel dataset that traces changes in the organizational structure and geographic presence of the U.S. federal government over the nineteenth century. To identify causal effects, we develop a new identification strategy that exploits the expansion of the railroad network as a source of variation in the travel time–and thus monitoring costs–between Washington D.C. and other locations. We present three main findings. First, reductions in travel time to Washington D.C. significantly increased the likelihood of federal government presence in a location. Second, this effect is stronger for occupations and tasks characterized by more severe agency problems. Third, decreases in travel time to Washington D.C. are associated with a decline in patrimonial features of the federal government in the location, in line with enhanced monitoring capacity reducing dependence on personal trust and connections.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了中央机构降低监控成本的技术如何塑造了从小型世袭国家向大型官僚组织的历史转型。我们的分析基于一个新颖的数据集，该数据集追踪了19世纪美国联邦政府组织结构与地理分布的变化。为识别因果效应，我们开发了一种新的识别策略，利用铁路网络的扩张作为华盛顿特区与其他地点之间旅行时间（即监控成本）变化的来源。我们提出三项主要发现：第一，前往华盛顿特区旅行时间的缩短显著增加了联邦政府在某一地点设立机构的可能性；第二，这种效应在代理问题更严重的职业和任务中更为显著；第三，前往华盛顿特区旅行时间的减少与当地联邦政府世袭特征的减弱相关，这与监控能力增强减少了对个人信任和关系依赖的结论一致。
title: State Capacity as an Organizational Problem
title_zh: 组织能力作为一个组织问题

abstract: Business dynamism -- the process of firm entry, growth and exit -- lies at the heart of modern endogenous growth models. While productivity differences have traditionally been seen as the main driving forces of business dynamism, a growing body of evidence suggests that customer acquisition is at least as important. In light of this evidence, we propose a novel endogenous growth model in which innovating firms must first acquire customers to sell their products. Estimating our model with aggregate and firm-level data, we find that expansions of firms' customer bases (market sizes) boost their incentives to innovate and shift resources towards high-growth businesses (“gazelles”). Combined, these effects explain over 40% of aggregate growth and substantially change predictions about the efficacy of growth policies. Finally, we document support for key model predictions using firm-level micro-data.
abstract_zh: 商业活力——企业进入、成长与退出的过程——是现代内生增长模型的核心。尽管生产率差异传统上被视为商业活力的主要驱动力，但越来越多的证据表明，客户获取至少同样重要。基于这一证据，我们提出了一种新颖的内生增长模型，其中创新企业必须首先获取客户才能销售其产品。通过使用总体数据和企业层面数据估计该模型，我们发现企业客户基础（市场规模）的扩张会增强其创新激励，并将资源转向高增长企业（“瞪羚企业”）。综合来看，这些效应解释了超过40%的总体增长，并显著改变了关于增长政策有效性的预测。最后，我们利用企业层面微观数据为模型的关键预测提供了支持证据。
title: Customer Acquisition, Business Dynamism and Aggregate Growth
title_zh: 客户获取、商业活力与总体增长

abstract: We explore the power that precise information about consumers’ preferences grants an intermediary in shaping competition. We think of an intermediary as an information designer who chooses what information to reveal to firms, which then compete à la Bertrand in a differentiated product market. We analyze the information designs that maximize consumer and producer surplus and uncover systematic differences in how information can be used to intensify or soften competition. Our analysis demonstrates the power that users’ data can endow intermediaries with and speaks directly to current regulatory debates regarding digital marketplaces.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了关于消费者偏好的精确信息赋予中间商在塑造竞争中的力量。我们将中间商视为信息设计者，由其选择向企业披露何种信息，随后企业在差异化产品市场中展开伯特兰式竞争。我们分析了最大化消费者剩余和生产者剩余的信息设计，揭示了信息在强化或缓和竞争方面可被系统性运用的差异。我们的分析表明，用户数据能够赋予中间商巨大力量，并直接回应了当前关于数字市场的监管辩论。
title: Market Segmentation through Information
title_zh: 基于信息分割的市场细分

abstract: In many markets, buyers make discrete choices between differentiated products and negotiate prices that are specific to the choice. We develop for estimation a model for this class of markets which is consistent with non-cooperative models of bargaining between a buyer and competing sellers. We show that when the buyer's utility has GEV disturbances, the model has a tractable likelihood function which can be used with transaction-level data giving the selected product and its price. We estimate the model using data from the UK brick industry and use it to measure market power and analyze mergers. We analyze how spatial differentiation and ownership concentration affect the distribution of market power across transactions. In counterfactuals we find that switching from individually-negotiated to uniform pricing causes markups, and merger price effects, to increase on average but to decrease for a minority of transactions.
abstract_zh: 在许多市场中，买家在差异化产品之间进行离散选择，并协商与选择相关的特定价格。我们针对这类市场开发了一个用于估计的模型，该模型与买家与竞争卖家之间非合作议价模型保持一致。我们证明，当买家效用具有广义极值（GEV）扰动时，该模型具有易于处理的似然函数，可结合提供所选产品及其价格的交易层面数据进行使用。我们利用英国砖业行业的数据对该模型进行估计，并以此衡量市场势力及分析并购。我们研究了空间差异化和所有权集中度如何影响交易间市场势力的分布。在反事实分析中，我们发现从单独协商定价转向统一定价会导致平均加成率及并购价格效应上升，但少数交易的加成率及并购价格效应反而下降。
title: Competition in a Spatially-Differentiated Product Market with Negotiated Prices
title_zh: 谈判价格下的空间差异化产品市场竞争

abstract: We present results from a field experiment that introduced digital payroll accounts to unbanked factory workers to examine how inexperienced consumers learn to use a new financial technology. We find that exposure to payroll accounts leads to increased account use, accelerated learning, and avoidance of common consumer protection risks. Those receiving electronic wage payments gradually build trust in the technology, learn to use accounts without assistance, and avoid illicit fees. Using experimental variation in assignment to bank versus mobile money accounts, we show that these impacts are concentrated in mobile money accounts, the newer, more complex, and less trusted financial technology.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项实地实验，向无银行账户的工厂工人引入数字工资账户，以考察缺乏经验的消费者如何学习使用新型金融技术。研究发现，接触工资账户能提升账户使用率、加速学习进程，并帮助规避常见的消费者保护风险。接受电子工资支付的工人逐渐建立起对该技术的信任，学会独立使用账户，并避免支付非法费用。通过实验性分配银行账户与移动货币账户的差异，我们证明这些影响主要集中在移动货币账户上——这是一种更新颖、更复杂且信任度较低的金融技术。
title: Learning to Navigate a New Financial Technology
title_zh: 学习驾驭新型金融技术

abstract: We ask what direct consumption data can reveal about the consumption-smoothing component of the insurance value of the Affordable Care Act Medicaid expansions. Medicaid expansion may reduce consumption risk by limiting exposure to out-of-pocket medical spending, but this channel may be muted when much uninsured care is financed through charity care, bad debt, or other forms of uncompensated care. We combine household expenditure data from the Consumer Expenditure Survey with the staggered timing of state Medicaid expansions to estimate effects on average consumption and on the within-education-group consumption distribution. We then map these estimated distributional effects into a static expected-utility framework. The exercise highlights both what this approach can reveal and where it is limited. Point estimates are largest for individuals without a high school degree and close to zero for higher-education groups, but the estimates are imprecise, including for average consumption. The resulting insurance-value calculations require additional assumptions and are also statistically imprecise. We therefore interpret the results as showing that existing consumption data can be used to bound the consumption-smoothing channel, but are not adequate to precisely estimate this component of the insurance value of Medicaid expansion. The findings clarify what can and cannot be learned from consumption data about this component of Medicaid’s value.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨直接消费数据能揭示《平价医疗法案》医疗补助扩展保险价值中的消费平滑成分。医疗补助扩展可能通过限制自付医疗支出来降低消费风险，但当大量未保险医疗通过慈善医疗、坏账或其他形式的无偿医疗来融资时，这一渠道可能被削弱。我们将消费者支出调查的家庭支出数据与各州医疗补助扩展的时间错开相结合，估计其对平均消费及教育组内消费分布的影响。随后，我们将这些估计的分布效应映射到一个静态期望效用框架中。这一实践既凸显了该方法能揭示的内容，也指出了其局限性。点估计显示，对未完成高中学历的个体影响最大，而对高等教育群体则接近零，但估计不精确，包括平均消费的估计也是如此。由此得出的保险价值计算需要额外假设，且在统计上也不精确。因此，我们将结果解读为：现有消费数据可用于界定消费平滑渠道的范围，但不足以精确估计医疗补助扩展保险价值的这一组成部分。这些发现阐明了消费数据在理解医疗补助价值这一方面能及不能提供的信息。
title: Estimating the consumption-smoothing value of Medicaid expansion: Evidence and limits
title_zh: 估算医疗补助扩展的消费平滑价值：证据与局限

abstract: As the economy has become increasingly knowledge-based, firms’ capability to benefit from external knowledge has grown in importance. We construct a measure of this capability – absorption intensity – from information in firms’ patents. To validate the measure, we exploit the American Inventors Protection Act (AIPA), which exogenously increased patent information availability. A triple-difference design shows that firms with higher absorption intensity experience greater innovation growth when more exposed to the reform. Beyond AIPA, absorption intensity predicts stronger innovation outcomes and firm growth. Our measure offers a tool to study how differences in absorption capability shape returns to external knowledge.
abstract_zh: 随着经济日益向知识密集型转型，企业从外部知识中获益的能力愈发重要。我们基于企业专利信息构建了一项衡量该能力的指标——吸收强度。为验证这一指标的有效性，我们利用了《美国发明人保护法案》（AIPA），该法案外生地增加了专利信息的可获得性。三重差分设计显示，在改革影响更显著的条件下，吸收强度较高的企业实现了更大的创新增长。除AIPA情境外，吸收强度还能预测更优的创新成果和企业成长。我们的指标为研究吸收能力差异如何影响外部知识回报提供了工具。
title: Measuring firms’ capability to absorb external knowledge
title_zh: 企业吸收外部知识能力的测度

abstract: We compute a common factor summarising asymmetries in the expected distributions of a large set of survey-based economic data series for the euro area. This expected skewness factor is distinct from lower-moment factors and can help improve forecasts of risks to economic activity and inflation. In addition, within a monthly vector autoregression (VAR), we show that revisions to survey-based expected skewness have macroeconomic and financial implications, even when the average assessment and expected volatility reflected in the surveys remain unchanged. The skewness measure could benefit economic policy institutions by supporting timely quantitative assessments of the balance of risks.
abstract_zh: 我们计算了一个共同因子，用以概括欧元区大量基于调查的经济数据序列预期分布中的不对称性。这一预期偏度因子区别于低阶矩因子，并能有助于改进对经济活动及通胀风险的预测。此外，在月度向量自回归（VAR）框架内，我们表明，即使调查中反映的平均评估和预期波动性保持不变，基于调查的预期偏度修正也会产生宏观经济和金融影响。该偏度指标可通过支持对风险平衡的及时定量评估，惠及经济政策机构。
title: A survey-based measure of asymmetric macroeconomic risk in the euro area
title_zh: 基于调查的欧元区非对称宏观经济风险度量
